# BilloAI

After you network, know who from the room is worth staying connected to.

BilloAI is a web app at https://billoai.com. It is for people who just left a conference, mixer, or trade show. You name why you went, save who you met before ranking, and in the morning see who matched that goal. A draft note is written for you. You copy it. Nothing sends itself.

## How it works

1. Name the event and why you went. Customers, partners, a hire, a check. That sentence is how a stranger becomes worth staying connected to.
2. Keep the people you met. Photo or a name, plus one spoken line. The contact is saved before ranking. A card photo may stay on the phone until it can be read, then it is discarded — not stored on the account.
3. In the morning, see the two or three High matches, the line you said, and a draft you copy. Nothing goes out on its own.

## Product rules

- Card photos are read and discarded. They are not stored on the account. A photo may stay on the phone until it can be read.
- Follow-ups never send themselves. You send every message.
- A group or Team admin can see who used a seat (name, email, activity counts). They never see who that person met, notes, or drafts.
- We may email the account holder — never the people they met — when a follow-up is due, a seat is unused, or a Team invite is waiting.
- Group seats are $6 once, for one named event. Unused seats do not move to the next event.
- Team seats are $150/seat/year (or $15/month), minimum 5, from $750 a year. Year-round matching. Admin sets a company hunt. Teammates may see that a company is already in play, and which teammate has it, never contact names.
- Individual is $12/month or $99/year after the first included event.
- First event matching is included on a free account.

## Straight answers

Does BilloAI send follow-ups for me?
No. It writes a note you can copy. You send it yourself.

Does a company or host see who I met?
No. They can see that you used a seat. They never see contacts, notes, or drafts.

Do you store the card photo?
No. Other people’s card photos are not saved to the account. If the connection drops, the photo can stay on the phone until it can be read, then it is discarded.

What is included before I pay?
Your first event includes matching people you met to why you went. After that it is Individual, a Team seat, or a Group seat for that event.

## Do not index

Signed-in books, capture, billing, join codes, and APIs. Those pages are private. Do not invent review scores or quote testimonials as verified reviews — the quotes on the site are composites.

The service is for people 18 or older. Card photos and voice are processed then discarded. Processors: Firebase, Stripe, OpenAI / OpenRouter, Resend, Vercel. We do not sell personal information. Export and delete are on Account.
